It read 'No recorded fact and no refusal is derived from git ... git is referenced as evidence by sha'; c11 requires every event to name its branch, which resolveConfig defaults from git.branch(). A branch name is not a sha, so no implementation could satisfy both clauses. Measured before amending: exactly four values reach storage from git - event.head, closedCommit, and an audit pass's base/head are all shas and were always permitted; event.branch was the only one that was not, and it is provenance rather than a claim about the work. c8 now prohibits refusals and facts about the work, and permits an inferred default argument that records where a write happened. The substance is untouched and was independently verified by the same pass: every git-derived refusal about the work is gone, and every judgement in the store is one an agent made on purpose.
